definition_used: Expression of Concern has been removed or is no longer applicable. Not to be confused with an “Upgraded to Retraction”
caution: This is a status-only notice about the removal of an Expression of Concern, not about the underlying content. It does not directly indicate a problem with research content, authorship, or editorial processes, but relates to post-publication transparency.
